attributes.name: Brutalized Flesh Golem
attributes.powers: You may display this card. While displayed, you may recharge this card to reduce damage other than Combat damage dealt to a character at your location to 0, or discard this card to explore your location; if you discard it, during this exploration, banish any boons you encounter and add 1d6 plus your number of mythic charges to your combat checks. While displayed, at the end of your turn, if you have mythic charges, banish this card.

While displayed, at the end of your turn, if you have mythic charges, banish this card.
corrections.issue: Brutalized Flesh Golem is only displayed if it gets into your hand via Skinstitcher's Manual. What if it gets into my hand some other way? Also, it seems like its powers should only function while displayed.
